dialect.detail: IBM DB2 for z/OS test program; DSNH error codes (DSNHSM5S, DSNHPARS) are DB2 precompiler/SQL messages; SOURCE-COMPUTER IBM-370; program-id DVZZMFT3 follows IBM naming convention; likely developed with IBM Rational Developer for z/OS (RDz, indicated by .rdz.cbl extension)

purpose.domain_detail: DB2 SQL ALTER SEQUENCE syntax validation test; exercises valid and invalid ALTER SEQUENCE options including RESTART, INCREMENT BY, MINVALUE, MAXVALUE, CYCLE, CACHE, ORDER
purpose.summary: This program is a test/validation suite for DB2 SQL ALTER SEQUENCE statements. It exercises numerous valid and invalid syntax combinations, with comments annotating expected DB2 precompiler error codes (DSNH*) for the invalid cases. It appears to be a developer test or regression case for DB2 sequence object DDL support.

notable_features: EXEC SQL ALTER SEQUENCE (DB2 DDL embedded SQL)
Multiple intentionally invalid SQL statements with expected DB2 error codes annotated in comments
IBM DB2 precompiler error message references (DSNH336I, DSNH637I, DSNH628I, DSNH846I, DSNH104I)
No DATA DIVISION content (no PIC clauses, no working-storage variables)
verdict.notes: The file is essentially a test harness with no real data division or business logic; it exists solely to validate DB2 ALTER SEQUENCE SQL syntax. The .rdz.cbl extension strongly suggests IBM Rational Developer for z/OS. High comment ratio (37%) due to annotated expected error codes.
